info.title: Python Game Server API
info.description:
## Game Server API

A comprehensive API for managing cybersecurity simulation games.

### Terminology

- **Event**: Runtime domain event emitted during gameplay and streamed via SSE
- **Directive**: Admin-defined, pre-game configuration that influences game rules
- **Factor**: Gameplay modifier created by black market purchases or directives
- **userId**: User identifier (never use playerId in client-facing code)

### Authentication

All endpoints except `/auth/*` and `/health` require JWT authentication:

- **Admin JWT**: Use `POST /auth/admin/login` with admin password from config
- **User JWT**: Use `POST /auth/signup` or `POST /auth/login`

Include JWT in the `Authorization` header: `Bearer <token>`

### Quick Start

1. **Admin login** → Get admin JWT token
2. **Configure directives** (optional) → Set up game rules/modifiers
3. **Configure all** → Create game with sides, teams, players, actions. Users are assigned to the game only via the teams/players in this request (no separate assign endpoint).
4. **User signup** → Create user accounts (before or after configure; include user_id in team players when configuring).
5. **User connects to SSE stream** → `GET /api/games/{gameId}/events/stream`
6. **Start game** → `POST /api/games/{gameId}/start` when all teams are ready (all assigned users connected at least once)

### Real-time Events (SSE)

- **Endpoint**: `GET /api/games/{gameId}/events/stream`
- **Auth**: JWT required (user must be assigned to the game)
- **Resume**: Pass `since=<seq>` to resume from a sequence number
- **Events**: USER_STREAM_CONNECTED, VOTE_CAST, ATTACK_RESOLVED, FACTOR_CREATED, etc.

### Entity IDs

All entities use **10-digit numeric IDs** as both database handles and frontend references.

### WebSocket

WebSocket endpoints have been removed in the SSE-only API.

post.description:
Register a new user account.

- **username**: Unique username (required)
- **password**: User password, will be hashed with bcrypt (required)

Returns a JWT token and user info on success.

Login with existing user credentials.

- **username**: Username (required)
- **password**: Password (required)

Returns a JWT token and user info on success.

Admin login with password from config.yml.

- **password**: Admin password configured in config.yml (required)

Returns a JWT token with admin role on success.

get.description:
Get full server-side game state (admin view).

Returns complete game state without player-specific context.
For player-scoped state, use `GET /client/game_state` with user JWT.

**Requires:** Admin JWT

400.description: No running game or server not initialized

get.description:
Health check endpoint.

Returns `{ "status": "ok" }` when server is running.
No authentication required.

post.description:
Configure a complete game in a single request.
Structure: versioned schema v1.0 only (teams/actions/action_counters/black_market).

example.detail: Cannot configure_all while a game is running. End or reset the current game first.

post.description:
Start the game identified by gameId (path param only).
Game must be the active game on server (configure_all sets it).
All teams must be ready (all assigned users have connected at least once).
Emits GAME_STARTED via SSE.

400.description: Game is not active, already started, or not all teams are ready

post.description:
Reset the game identified by gameId (path param only).
Game must be the active game on server.
Emits GAME_RESET via SSE.

get.description:
List all registered users.

- **skip**: Number of records to skip (pagination)
- **limit**: Maximum records to return

**Requires:** Admin JWT

post.description:
Configure game directives (replaces all existing directives).

Directives are admin-defined pre-game rules that modify gameplay.
They are NOT the same as runtime SSE events.

**Directive Effect Types:**
- `probability`: Modify action success probability
- `cost`: Modify action costs
- `growth`: Modify growth factor accumulation
- `tech`: Modify tech factor accumulation
- `limit`: Disable certain actions

**Requires:** Admin JWT

**Events Emitted:**
- DIRECTIVE_SET for each directive (admin-scoped)

Add directives to existing configuration for the current game (game-scoped).

**Requires:** Admin JWT. A game must be configured first (configure_all).

delete.description:
Delete a specific directive by name for the current game (game-scoped).

**Requires:** Admin JWT. A game must be configured first (configure_all).

Clear all configured directives for the current game (game-scoped).

**Requires:** Admin JWT. A game must be configured first (configure_all).

get.description:
Get all configured directives for the current game (game-scoped).

**Requires:** Admin JWT. A game must be configured first (configure_all).

Get directives that are currently active for the current turn (game-scoped).

**Requires:** Admin JWT. A game must be configured first (configure_all).

Get game state from the player's perspective.

Includes `clientContext` with current user/team/side IDs.
`data.game.phase` is the coarse lifecycle (`waiting|ongoing|finished`).
`data.game.currentPhase` is the current turn phase (`GOVERNMENT_SELECTION|SELECTION|VOTING|CALCULATION`).
All entity references use 10-digit numeric IDs.

**Requires:** User JWT with assigned game

403.description: User is not assigned to the active game

get.description:
Get available actions for the current player.

Returns the player's role-scoped action catalog with 10-digit IDs.
This endpoint is configuration-oriented: it returns eligible actions for the team even when the current turn phase
does not allow casting that vote yet. Use `POST /client/vote_action` and SSE/game-state phase fields for live gating.

**Requires:** User JWT with assigned game

400.description: Player not found or action catalog unavailable

403.description: User is not assigned to the active game

get.description:
Get available targets for attack actions.

Returns enemy teams that can be targeted, with their 10-digit IDs.

**Requires:** User JWT with assigned game

400.description: Player not found or targets unavailable

403.description: User is not assigned to the active game

post.description:
Submit a vote for an action.

**Format:** Use 10-digit IDs
- `action_id`: Action ID
- `target_team_id`: Target team ID (for attacks)
- `black_market_item_id`: Optional item ID

**Requires:** User JWT with assigned game

get.description:
SSE endpoint for streaming game events in real-time.

**ENROLLMENT REQUIREMENT:**
A user may connect to this stream ONLY if admin has assigned them to the game.
When an assigned user connects, it is treated as a presence + enrollment signal.

**Authentication:**
- `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header
- OR `?token=<jwt>` query parameter for EventSource/SSE clients

**Resume:**
- Pass `since=<seq>` to resume from a specific sequence number
- Client should store last processed `seq` and pass it on reconnect

**Filtering:**
- Pass `types=VOTE_CAST,TURN_ENDED` to filter by event types

**Visibility:**
- Events are automatically filtered based on user's team/side
- PUBLIC events visible to all
- TEAM events visible only to team members
- PLAYER events visible only to specific user

**Connection Events:**
- On connect: USER_STREAM_CONNECTED emitted
- On disconnect: USER_STREAM_DISCONNECTED emitted
- Team readiness checked: TEAM_READY, ALL_TEAMS_READY may be emitted

**Response Headers:**
- Content-Type: text/event-stream
- Cache-Control: no-cache
- Connection: keep-alive
- X-Accel-Buffering: no (for Nginx)

**Event Format:**
```
id: <seq>
event: <event_type>
data: {"seq": 1, "type": "VOTE_CAST", "payload": {...}, ...}
```

**Keepalive:**
- Server sends a keepalive event every ~10-15 seconds
- Format: `event: keepalive\ndata: {"timestamp": ..., "seq": ...}\n\n`

403.description: User is not assigned to this game

get.description:
Get events for replay/catch-up (non-streaming).

Use this endpoint to:
- Fetch missed events after reconnect
- Replay events for state reconstruction
- Debug event history

**Parameters:**
- `since_seq`: Get events with seq > since_seq
- `until_seq`: Get events with seq <= until_seq (optional)
- `types`: Comma-separated event type filter
- `limit`: Max events to return (default 100, max 1000)

delete.description:
Admin endpoint to clear all events for a game.

**Warning:** This is destructive and cannot be undone.

**Requires:** Admin JWT

get.description:
Get event stream status for a game.

Returns:
- Current sequence number
- Total event count
- Connection info

403.description: User is not assigned to this game

get.description:
Get team readiness status for a game.

Shows which teams are ready (all assigned users connected at least once)
and which users are currently connected.

**Readiness Model:**
- Connected presence (ephemeral): User is currently connected to SSE stream
- Ready achieved (durable): User has connected at least once
- Team ready: All assigned users have achieved readiness
- All teams ready: All teams are ready, game can start

Returns:
- Per-team readiness info
- Overall readiness status
- Connected user counts
